about.title: About
about.html:
We are a builder community for ambitious people.

We are looking for builders turning hardware, software, and ML ideas into real projects. We do builder-led incubation by giving builders space, resources, time, and a community that helps them ship.

What it’s like to be here is best described by one of our members:
“There are highly ambitious, high willpower and funny people with whom its good to build, have a coffee and nice discussion. We all want basically the same thing. To add value, make a change, solve a problem and learn. But also to enjoy the bright side of life. I like that.”

We are up and running since 2023 in Budapest. A lot has changed since then but our mission is the same: to let builders build. Currently we have 3 years behind us, 50 members, 2 funded startups and many projects in the making.

Read our full story from the very beginning: /posts/mesh-retro

What does it actually look like?

We have a physical space in Budapest.

We have a community of builders being here day and night building.

We organize plenty of events. Demo nights every 3 weeks where members demo what they’re building. We have seminars to learn from each other. Jam sessions to make music and have fun. You name it, we organize it.
Work hard, play hard, right?

Okay, but what’s the deal?

We provide the environment, you bring the drive to build. This is the equation to become a great builder at mesh.

What we propose

  • A vibrant community & teammates
  • Opportunities for growth
  • Mentorship from builders
  • Office space & other resources
  • A testing platform
  • Engineer-led guidance

What we require

  • Dedication to building bold
  • Frequent communication
  • Active participation in community life
  • Continuous learning
  • Collaborative mindset

Join us

join.title: Join
join.html:
The onboarding period is designed to answer one question: Can you build?

How to become a mesh. member?

  1. Join our Discord server
    Join us on Discord and introduce yourself to the community
  2. Application
    Submit your application - share your project idea and what drives you to build it.
  3. Interview
    30-minute conversation with a mesh. founder/core builder
  4. 6-week build
    You join as a Candidate and start hands on building while you get mentorship, access to builderspace, community events, resources
  5. Demo night
    Demo what you build to mesh. members (demo nights every 3 weeks)
  6. Get selected
    Earn your spot as a full member and unlock all resources.

Start the application

You have questions or doubts?
→ Check out what projects would be cool to apply with here.
→ Or reach out here and visit us at mesh.
